title: 3D Physics Mahjong
description: Pick matching 3D mahjong tiles from a tumbling physics pile into your tray, using flip, shuffle, clear, and undo tools to empty the table.
controls: Tap 3D mahjong tiles to move them into the tray; match three identical tiles to clear them. Use Shuffle, Flip, Clear, and Undo buttons below.

zh-CN.title: 3D 物理麻将
zh-CN.description: 在拟真 3D 物理堆叠的麻将牌阵中挑出三张相同牌面装槽消除，活用洗牌、翻牌、消除与回退道具通关。
zh-CN.controls: 点击 3D 麻将牌收入底部卡槽，凑齐三张相同牌面自动消除；底部支持洗牌、翻牌、消除和回退道具。
